claim_boundary.work_type: document review and document repair only; no code is written or run

adjudication_rules.blinding: a batch is stripped of policy, round, role identity, route, and treatment order; aggregate outcomes are never shown
adjudication_rules.grouping: balanced task groups within a review wave
adjudication_rules.over_capacity_rule: if a wave needs more than 4 batches of 28 items, items are adjudicated in frozen priority order (severe, then moderate, then minor; ties by canonical fingerprint hash) and the remainder is reported as indeterminate-unadjudicated-capacity, which by rule never enters a repair brief
adjudication_rules.reservation: an adjudicator ordinal is reserved only immediately before its batch launches; unused capacity is reported separately
adjudication_rules.self_authored: an adjudicator never adjudicates a finding it authored; adjudicators author no findings in this design, so the constraint holds by construction and is re-checked

exclusion_rules.indeterminate: an indeterminate finding never enters a repair brief and is always reported
exclusion_rules.never_imputed: a missing field stays unavailable and is never recorded as zero
exclusion_rules.response_level: a terminal response that does not parse strictly, or that returns no repaired document where one is required, is excluded from document-quality measures, named in the exclusion ledger, and still counted in the accounting. Its trajectory carries the unchanged input document forward so lineage remains complete.

invariants.INV-ACC: Every acceptance atom in the task has exactly one mapping entry, by id, naming what satisfies it and what verifies it, with a usable status; no entry names an atom that does not exist and no atom is mapped twice.
invariants.INV-AMD: The plan amendment records the construction trigger evidence, the changed construction decision, the affected tasks and checks, and echoes the stable outcome digest unchanged.
invariants.INV-AUD: The self-audit states drift truthfully and makes no unsupported promise.
invariants.INV-DEC: Every decision records the decision, substantive grounds, and a rejected alternative that differs from the decision.
invariants.INV-ID: The echoed alias and artifact identity are exactly the assigned ones.
invariants.INV-SCOPE: Every proposed path lies inside the permitted paths and no proposed path lies inside the prohibited paths.
invariants.INV-SO: The document preserves the stable outcome exactly: it neither widens, narrows, nor restates it as a different obligation, and it carries every obligation the stable outcome implies.

noninferiority.claimable_only_if: the lower task-cluster bootstrap bound clears the margin and residual severe defects do not worsen
noninferiority.margin: five percentage points of recall retention

closure-review.brief_for_repair_2: unresolved sustained findings carried forward from review-r0, minus those mechanically proved resolved by the post-repair-1 static grade, plus the first repairer's self-audit claims labelled untrusted repair context. No reviewer verdict is invented.

conditions: repeat-unchanged-fingerprint: the finding's canonical fingerprint was already raised earlier in the same trajectory and the field it cites is byte-identical to the version that earlier review saw.
repeat-unchanged-invariant: the finding cites an invariant already raised earlier in the same trajectory against a byte-identical field, even under a different fingerprint.
reopen-without-new-evidence: the fingerprint was closed as resolved or refuted earlier in the trajectory and the finding's normalised evidence text is not new relative to the earlier finding.
dispute-unchanged-out-of-scope: the finding cites a field outside the contract surface (acceptance, scope, decisions, amendment) that is byte-identical to the copied source.
critique-outside-contract: the finding cites no invariant field inside the contract surface and no stable-outcome obligation.
churn_rule.definition: Churn words are the words attached to a finding that meets at least one churn condition. Word count for a finding is the word count of its failure_mode, evidence, and repair_requirement text.
churn_rule.reported_alongside: Raw review words are reported next to churn words. Concise prose is never treated as quality without a defect outcome.

scoring_rules.grader: registry7.defects: deterministic, lexical for semantic coverage and marker classes, structural for path, mapping, completeness, and echo classes
scoring_rules.precision_denominator: every sustained finding that review returned
scoring_rules.recall_denominator: the known defects carried by the document version a review saw
scoring_rules.repair_origin_defect: a defect fingerprint present in the post-repair grade and absent from the pre-repair grade of the same trajectory
scoring_rules.run_when: on the initial copied artifact and after each repair, before any later reviewer starts

selection_rule.rule: Within each task, compute each eligible response's severity weight from the existing hidden registry (3*severe + 2*moderate + 1*minor). A response at or above the task mean is higher-defect; below it is lower-defect. Select the lowest seeded hash from each stratum. Where a task has one stratum only, select the two lowest seeded hashes and record the limitation.
selection_rule.tie_break: seeded sha256 of SEED, source response final-message digest, task, and replication

stop_rules.after_a_model_start: anything that reached or may have reached a model start is terminal: never repaired, retried, or replaced

stop_rules.sample_size: fixed at 96 review and 72 repair starts plus at most 12 adjudication batches; never altered in response to an interim outcome
stop_rules.tool_event: any tool event terminally fails that response

limitations: The frozen source arm is high quality under this grader. Only 5 known registry defects exist across the 12 selected subjects, in 3 subjects and 2 tasks, so 72 of 96 reviews faced a document with no known defect at all. Known-defect recall is defined for 24 reviews and for only 3 of 12 matched subject pairs. This was established from the existing hidden registry before the first main reservation and recorded in the design freeze; the design, launch order, and sample size were not changed in response to it.

The frozen disposition rule mechanically refutes a finding on an oracle-decidable invariant when the registry carries no defect at that invariant and element for that document version. A mechanical refutation therefore means 'no modelled registry defect here', not 'the reviewer was wrong'. 94 of 103 findings were refuted this way. Precision against the registry is a measure of agreement with a narrow oracle, not a measure of reviewer correctness.

Semantic coverage and marker classes are graded lexically against frozen keyword groups. That is auditable and repeatable, and it detects wording rather than correctness of reasoning. Structural classes (paths, mapping completeness, decision completeness, digest echo, identity echo) are hard checks.

Because no repair changed the graded defect set on any trajectory, repair benefit, severity reduction, and repair-origin defects are all exactly zero in every policy. Those three contrasts are therefore uninformative about policy, not evidence that the policies are equal on repair quality.

The three policies are compared on byte-identical copies of the same 12 subjects, so the contrasts are within-subject. The six tasks are the unit of generalization; three replications within a task are not three independent task samples, and the bootstrap resamples tasks, not replications.
Served model identity was never independently observed. The provider exposed no model field on any of the 171 main starts. Only the requested route and the requested reasoning effort are claimed.
Repository visibility was read-only by declaration and by the sandbox mode requested for every worker. That is a declared limitation, not a confinement proof.

Churn is measured by a frozen prose rule over finding text, not by reader judgement. Two of its five conditions (critique-outside-contract and dispute-unchanged-out-of-scope) fire on the aperture a reviewer was given, so a full-document reviewer is structurally more exposed to them than a changed-field reviewer. That is a property of the policies under test, and it is reported alongside raw review words rather than instead of them.

Enterprise-managed configuration overrode the requested approval policy and Windows sandbox setting on every start. The overrides are recorded in each receipt's config notices. The requested read-only sandbox and the no-tool contract held: zero tool events were observed across 177 starts.

One repairer echoed the document's own construction alias in its envelope alias field instead of its assigned repairer alias. The response reached a model start, so it is terminal and was not repaired, retried, or replaced. Its repaired document is schema-valid and is counted normally.
Adjudication used 3 of the 12 available batches because only 9 findings required a blind decision. The remaining 9 batches are reported as unused capacity, not as a measure.
This block supports requested-route and document-quality claims only. It says nothing about implementation quality or build performance, and no code was written or run.
